newsitem.title: USA: Ukraine IMF standby put at $550 mln--source.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine IMF standby put at $550 mln--source.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund standby loan for Ukraine is likely to be for $550 million, an international monetary source said on Tuesday.
That would be less than the $750 million figure given by Ukrainian officials. The loan would be an interim arrangement prior to possible agreement on a three-year program.

The IMF's Kiev representative Goohoon Kwon said earlier on Tuesday that the standby loan had been agreed in principle, although a deal would still have to be approved by the IMF board. Kwon said the standby would be temporary and the two sides would move quickly to negotiations on an extended loan.
